title: DtMF World Tour Night 1 in Lisbon — 65,000 Fans Pack Estádio da Luz for Portugal Debut
detail: Bad Bunny performed the first of two consecutive sold-out nights at Estádio da Luz in Lisbon on May 26, 2026 — his first-ever stadium concert in Portugal. The 65,000-capacity venue sold out within hours of tickets going on sale in May 2025, with over one million purchase attempts logged. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour production brought its full 360-degree stage design to Portugal, including 'La Casita' — the intimate second-stage structure from which Bad Bunny performed acoustic and bachata-inflected renditions mid-show. The setlist spanned the full DtMF album alongside legacy tracks from Un Verano Sin Ti, El Último Tour del Mundo, and YHLQMDLG. Portuguese press noted that the two Lisbon nights represented the largest single Latin music event in the country's history by paid attendance (130,000 total across both nights). The Portugal News published same-day coverage headlined 'Bad Bunny marks presence in Portugal,' noting his status as Spotify's most-streamed artist in 2025, his Grammy and Latin Grammy recognition, and his 2026 Super Bowl halftime show appearance. The Lisbon run bridges the European leg from Barcelona (May 22–23) into the 10-night Madrid residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano beginning May 30.
